summary: Completed frontend-only testing of NeXify Next.js app. Homepage renders correctly with German UI, but CRITICAL ISSUE: React hydration is failing - no interactive features work (chat cannot open/close, no event handlers attached). Static HTML renders perfectly but client-side JavaScript is not hydrating the page.

critical_bugs.issue: React client-side hydration is completely failing. No __NEXT_DATA__ script tag found, no React Fiber attached to DOM elements, no event handlers working. The app serves static HTML only without interactivity.
critical_bugs.impact: BLOCKS ALL INTERACTIVE FEATURES - chat cannot open/close, buttons don't work, no state management
evidence: Workspace component has no React Fiber: hasFiber=False
Chat launcher button has no event handlers: onclick=False, hasReactProps=False
No __NEXT_DATA__ script tag found in page

ui_bugs.issue: Chat panel does not open when launcher button is clicked. Panel remains hidden with hidden=true attribute and workspace-shell stays 'is-closed'

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix Next.js React hydration failure. The app is serving static HTML without client-side JavaScript hydration. Investigation shows: (1) No __NEXT_DATA__ script tag in page, (2) No React Fiber attached to DOM elements, (3) No event handlers working. This blocks ALL interactive features including the required chat open/close/resize functionality. Possible causes: Next.js build configuration issue, missing client-side bundle, or deployment/routing problem preventing JavaScript from loading. Check: next.config.js/ts settings, build output, script tag generation, and ensure client-side bundles are being served correctly.
